object: Founded in 1912 by Belgian industrialist Ernest Solvay. Organizes the Solvay Conferences on Physics and Chemistry — closed conclaves of 20–30 leading scientists, fully funded, with pre-circulated reports and structured discussion. Closer to a summit than a conference. The tradition continues to the present day.
